title: Sample In-House Review Permit Application Completeness Letter

paragraphs: Complete In-House Review permit applications will receive a letter prior to plan check.

In-House Review building permit applications submitted through the application portal , will be assigned a permit application number and then reviewed for completeness. We will confirm that the application is complete and that all the required supporting documents have been included.
Once that review is complete, we will email you a letter like the sample below indicating that your application is complete and accepted.

If the application is not complete, we will send you a letter stating that your application is incomplete and will need to be resubmitted with additional information. This letter will clearly state what information is missing and needs to be included with your resubmission.
